systemConfig.title: Business Settings
systemConfig.description: Platform-wide business configuration. Backend is authoritative; these values are consumed by business logic.

commission.title: Commission Rules
commission.description: Marketplace commission rules. The applicable rule is resolved by scope (merchant over category over global), priority, and effective dates.
commission.targetHint: Leave merchant and category empty for a global rule. Provide only one.
commission.historicalNote: Changing a rule affects future transactions only. Historical commission is snapshotted per transaction and is never recalculated.

payment.title: Payment Methods
payment.description: Enable or disable customer payment methods. Availability is served by the backend; the app never hardcodes it.
payment.name: Name
